notes.title: the world of hamachi #6
notes.content:
[p]happy fall, the last post was 2 months ago so I want to briefly share some stuff ive been working on  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/96f7e4dffa0d21e3a4296bea543b59bbc0941442.png"][/img]firstly, I made a few new batch of levels to have fun with that will [u]become available around halloween[/u] called 'hamachi.exe', Im sure you can figure out what inspired that name.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/ce279e89d0dd1ea3f2eba38dc0281c7bbb39ec20.png"][/img]I suggest that when you play these new levels, you make sure to increase your volume up by a lot to really [i][b]immerse[/b][/i] yourself with the experience..
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/KJ16Zhn.gif"][/img][/p][p]in regards to the main game itself, im focusing my time on wrapping up the actual bosses now. I've finished coding the 2nd boss encounter, his name is 'yawning lord yellow devil', and he utilizes a companion called the 'haphazard demon cube' to perform most of his attacks. the cube defaults to red, and can change to yellow, purple and green to indicate what action he is going to perform with the cube. he has 3 phases and unlocks a new ability each phase.  however, if you dont want to kill the bosses, you can now properly pacify them   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/7d4d1638b616803b26acc72f16155e0f0b2f1331.gif"][/img]the bosses in this world are merely outcasts, victims of the main antagonist, "[i]the demon queen[/i]" much like hamachi (the player controlled character) is.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/93946698bb4257f6c6e089d00372421703c14196.gif"][/img][/p][p]when you pacify them, they will poof away and join you via the demonic trinket, "orb of the bound", which binds their soul to the player. this will be used in a successful pacifist route to summon the now party members to assist you in the final battle.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/19446111e07051f527eadc31cec52f659db03952.png"][/img]youll do something nice for him   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/705040fb149a114d5b02ab1f1bb84af047b86c3a.png"][/img]the boss you spare will happily hang out on the title screen, rooting for you  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/352e8e3b16fbfbe8c6084901ce81ad83c6f896e5.png"][/img]lastly something minor, you can now adjust the volume, and your options will be saved, so If you prefer playing in window mode, the game will always boot in window mode after confirming that in options.[/p][p][i]also, hamachi has an idle animation now, thats the most groundbreaking thing out of everything ive just said[/i][/p][p]
to give a general projection, I've set myself the goal to complete coding on or before April 2026, thats the latest I want to give myself.

theres certainly more to go over, but that would spoil everything ! so I'll end it at that

Price Adjustment:

One of the biggest pieces of feedback I receive is that the current amount of content doesn't yet feel like it justifies the original price point, and I agree with this, so I've decided to reduce the price of the game to $4.99 during Early Access, and then at which point it will return to the original price once the game is officially done. I want to thank all of you who have supported me and I apologize to anyone who purchased the game and was left disappointed! It's my first game, I'm learning, I hope this is more acceptable![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]I want to clarify that development is very healthy, and in regards to the content in general, I'm going to update the game with another world to go alongside the 3 that are currently there, soon![/p]

notes.title: the world of hamachi #3
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/ehfYC7g.png"][/img][i]he has mail for you, a preview of some small content planned for june 25th[/i]  •ᴗ•[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/0n0NlXQ.png"][/img][/p][p] 
some may already know, i want to keep things [i]fresh[/i] and gradually introduce new content while im stuck in The Backrooms stitching together the main game, and im doing so with [i]'challenge levels'.[/i] they're short but tougher levels that reward a steam achievement upon completion.  

[img src="https://i.imgur.com/1QE4vdC.gif"][/img]now featuring their own dedicated menu screen, the 2nd one will go live soon, a total of 10 are planned. (that thing floating above the screen may or may not wake up and freak out once you finish them all)  [img src="https://i.imgur.com/fuWAyzk.gif"][/img][b]Challenge Level #2 Story:  

[/b][i]The demon possessing Hamachis mind (Demon Queen Deity) is in search of the [b]Soul Stone Shards[/b], fragments of an artifact that when combined together, create the [b]Soul Stone Artifact[/b]. When this artifact is consumed by a Demon, it grants them INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS ([b]and slightly controversial[/b]) POWER. Demon Queen Deity believes this Tomb holds one of the shards, and is speculated to be guarded by another Demon.  [/i][img src="https://i.imgur.com/xhLWxzj.gif"][/img][i]Unfortunately, deep within the Tomb, they happen to only discover a refreshing can of Yellow Soft Drink, called, "[b]SUPER PSYCHO SODA[/b]" (made with real LEMONS), perfect for a hot Summer day. Utilizing this beverage, Hamachi discovers he's equipped himself with a new attack ability, that makes enemies pop, literally.   [/i][img src="https://i.imgur.com/JD6HzY1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/a1b68bacffc6b73a7a2e391dbf0e402a13dbdf7a.gif"][/img]
lastly, the [b][i]characters[/i][/b] page found in [b][i]Options[/i][/b] will be updated to display a short description about each character, I would check it out if you're interested to learn more about them!

*[i]in other news, this game will receive a temporary discount during the next major steam sale, whenever that may be. if you have interest in purchasing, i would wait until then! also, the website has been updated once again, and has been given a huge makeover, you can now play the demo in your browser![/i][/p][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/TGWQubz.png"][/img]enjoy your summer~ ! ⋆｡°✩[/p]

notes.title: the world of hamachi #2
notes.content:
i... am steve, and this is #2 of a series of posts ill be making to act as a space for me to just talk and yap and share things that im working on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/b993c885c1dac3149657f2caee036a79e1dbdc95.gif[/img]
to start off, the website has now evolved into its final form (for now at least), its very clean, very presentable. and an html5 version of the game can now be played from the website, to some degree at least. this game now exists on windows, mac, your browser, if theres demand for it, maybe one day linux, or a toaster, maybe one day in movie theaters and I can get Chris Pratt to voice act the characters. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/59adf0a46bea56565d1dece502d980563e202ff5.png[/img]
[i]*the following content im talking about here is not available in the current version of the game on steam.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/047560a54b7ecfddd93f43decd5f11c8a2ffb73a.png[/img]
as of recently ive been putting together the second boss, who goes by the name of [i]Yawning Lord Yellow Devil[/i]. another victim of demon queen deity. he attempts to swiftly put an end to hamachi using his raw strength, only to be deflected by hamachis possessor. in a quick change of plans, he unveils the [i]Haphazard Demon Cube[/i], a demonically charged instrument of chaos magic that sends whoever touches it into an alternate dimension. yellow devil flees into the cube and hamachi gives chase, jumping from dimension to dimension by completing short rapid challenges. if the player fails a challenge, they get sent back to the initial starting room..... im not surprised if ur wondering, what the hell did I just read? but yeah that's the boss
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/2b88f193384462553872d5ff8f9f7be84f1ea05d.gif[/img]
the goal of each challenge is to reach the cube within a set amount of time, theres a lot of variety. for instance, you might get stuck in a world where your forced to run track. (just dont stop and look at the spectators, you dont belong there. and they know it.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/35140985bbee040e71c0589908393c7b6c3b512d.png[/img]
or you'll need to fish the cube out from a claw machine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/c98bc832e56f6a42d838437a1541795e5ccd0bd9.gif[/img]

take on a fight with an observer riding on a piece of two legged sushi
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/7267a5c64ff8838695dc370d3162a784176f8150.png[/img]
get to work with your newly acquired medical license
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/e9eaac36efd505a6cb378df9c28805d67b32cbd6.png[/img]
run away from [i]the beast[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/64c43700c80abf48d1ffc11c3c92b0c0d4d316e7.gif[/img]

catch the cube!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/5f1beaeb4eea9a6c39ca8e0a3701fe5e30f5b50b.png[/img]

offer some emotional support?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/3359dc66e7deb8ddaaecb3aabfe29a5e0f33714d.png[/img]

determine which route you'll pursue further
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/845c0346c869173d13d8f08e1cdb891d14debf6d.png[/img]

or find yourself stuck in hell against a mini boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/0b0a5f9e8fc9f6b452470db0c45e6fd76e6d399b.png[/img]

suddenly the sky is a little clearer, the water is a little bluer, the roads a little bumpier, the jumps are harder, thelevelsdeeper,thecharacterssmarter,thesoundisharder,thegraphicscooler,thesecretsdarker,thedangersfierceandthechallengeawholelotTOUGHER.

then suddenly you realize this cube could do anything, [i]ZERO LIMITS[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323260/7414a23625c390f37af52e7ff03b88fbe26a3e78.png[/img]

i dont want to spoil how this comes to an end. so this comes the end of this post.

notes.title: the world of hamachi #1
notes.content:
hello, this is #1 of a series of posts ill be making to act as a space for me to just talk and share things that im working on, occasionally ill share some quirky unexpected bits that Ive encountered during development too... like this:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XUvA20l.png[/img]
when I was setting up the Mac build, a sentient cloud spawned in the water out of thin air, the enemies walking around the stage floor turned into tiny bits of themselves, and the "press start" text turned into- another cloud

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OHBHNh7.png[/img]
or if you press '6' on your keyboard, the game will slowly die from lag as it endlessly spawns enemies, and invisible objects that push you around if you get too close, (if you do this in the demo it just crashes the game, thats it, just a dedicated crash the game button) whats more confusing is that I intentionally programmed this to happen, but I cant remember why 

anyway, theres a website now
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BsXSxWD.png[/img]
im happy to have it registered, and that it exists, but its super barebones atm as I made it in under 8 hours, and my web design skills aren't all too sharp, but in time it'll grow, ill develop it

lets see what else...
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4LASkng.png[/img]
introducing a new mechanic called [i]the eeper[/i] ([i]official[/i] name), if you die about 4-5 times, this boss becomes eepy due to the boredom of winning all the time. the introductory sequence automatically skips, and his hp takes on a random value of 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10, so you can get a couple of free hits on him before your attacks wake him up, this is so you can easily jump back in if you find yourself getting stuck. I also (again) adjusted the amount of time he waits before puking up one of those red balls, hopefully making the fight significantly easier at the start

oh yeah, and the police actually try now. I always disliked how hamachi just seemed to outrun them so easily, but now that the player can dash, they have that ability too
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vaSRT4j.png[/img]

your no longer going to make that jump tho..
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J0jSrmn.png[/img]
[i]the light doth flee from mine eyes[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RyRNPDJ.png[/img]

speaking of dashing, if ur moving right, and double tap the left arrow, you will dash to the right. and if you are moving left, and double tap the right arrow, you will dash to the left. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UaWQMMX.png[/img]
its a bug, but do I dare revisit this mess to fix it? or do I just call it a feature? I mean it's not broken, it makes dashing mid air easier, and dashing easier in general. its a feature.

I should wrap things up now, so to end with my thoughts 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X2XntF3.png[/img]
I kinda want to do local multiplayer, and I kind of dont, I feel like having the option would be cool, but at the same time, I feel like it would just be a matter of who manages to press the run button fast enough, and then the second player would be stuck trailing behind.. well multiplayer "kind of works" already (it has been documented) so the foundation is there if I manage to figure that out.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3l1ieyw.png[/img]
ty 4 reading, and stay tuned, im looking forward to showing off some things that aren't available in the current iteration of the game right now (other worlds). can you guess what "the world of hamachi" name is a play on? 

oh yeah I almost forgot, someone asked who the person floating next to hamachi is on the end game screen, thats the main villain of the games universe that you learn about during the introduction sequence. its not mentioned in game, but she has two forms. she can be a floating disembodied head, or transform into something more human. why? she can do that because

notes.title: Update for Mar 1
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kUGvNsr.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Added: Attack Mode Toggle[/b]
Normally, when you press the attack button, the character comes to a complete halt until the animation ends. Now, you can toggle this off or on anytime during gameplay, indicated by a lock graphic. This allows you to spam the attack button and maintain full movement. The attack will register in the direction you're facing when you press the button.

[*][b]Adjusted Enemy Knockback[/b]
Sometimes when you would bump into a pair of "enemies", they would blast you off into the stratosphere, I've turned a 1 into a 0 so (hopefully) this won't happen anymore. Although this should be fine for now, I need to start restocking my supply of glue and duct tape and get under the hood because I think it could be better, it's a mess in there.

[*][b]Polish[/b]
The best update saved for last. notes.title: 1.1: Update Notes for Feb 10
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 2 new achievements.
[*] Introduced a new Challenge Level. A dedicated menu for Challenge Levels will be added as more are introduced.
[*] Salutations Feline’s attack damage has been nerfed from 1000 to 987.5. Hopefully, this keeps things balanced.
[*] Added dialogue for cops—please refrain from tampering with the community’s highly important government-issued wetness dispensers, which exist to keep the grass in Riches Reef slightly less dead.
[*] Adjusted movement timer for Major Domo Doomsavant's Genocide fight.
[*] Published Game Manual
[/list]
